scripts.admin:create: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run build -w @saleshub/api && node scripts/admin.mjs
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run build -w @saleshub/api && node --env-file=.env apps/api/dist/src/seed-demo.js
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run build -w @saleshub/api && concurrently -k -n web,api,types "npm run dev -w @saleshub/web" "node --env-file=.env --watch apps/api/dist/src/main.js" "npm run watch -w @saleshub/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run build -w @saleshub/api && npm run build -w @saleshub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run test -w @saleshub/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run build -w @saleshub/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/integration.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @saleshub/shared && npm run build -w @saleshub/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/integration.mjs --browser
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
